findings.summary: r1 blocker (deferred no-listener rejection terminal, Parity 10 → I3) is fixed on this tree: the trap now prints and requests `uint8(exitCode ?? 1)` at once, records the exit signal, and a later exit() adds no request; an exit() already requested keeps its status with no stderr. Residual edge carried from r1: #requestSelfExit checks #controlClosed before #selfExitRequested, and #terminal is set only after requestExit returns, so a closed control port makes fatal()/a later exit() throw a plain Error out of the trap instead of the exit signal. Reading only.
